sources: Baseball Savant (xERA, xwOBA, ERA, wOBA — season to date)
MLB Stats API (K%, BB% from season stats)
ATC (projected FIP from user's Excel upload)
Fangraphs ROS DC projections — ATC DC / The BAT X / OOPSY DC / ZiPS DC (FIP)

unified_score.method: rolling-led in-season core (stabilized 0.6*L5 + 0.4*season xFIP/SIERA + xERA/botERA), blended vs projection with a DYNAMIC weight w_season = IP/(IP+K) that grows with innings (K_SP=14, K_RP=20); plus a small rolling K-BB% trend nudge.
